description: Glide to an input and type text at a human pace (keystroke by keystroke — it reads as real usage, not a paste). Use realistic demo content; whatever you type is on tape.

delay_ms.description: Per-keystroke delay in milliseconds. Optional; default 45. Lower = faster typing (e.g. 25); higher = more deliberate.

input_text.description: The literal text to type; it appears on tape keystroke by keystroke, so use realistic demo content (never real secrets).

selector.description: CSS selector of the input, textarea, or contenteditable to type into, e.g. 'input[name=email]'. Must be focusable and visible.

name: studio_type
